CheckoutRequest.description: Authenticated checkout uses address_id. Guest checkout requires items and guest when checkout.require_authentication is false.

x-error-codes.UNAUTHENTICATED: Authentication credentials are missing or invalid.
x-error-codes.FORBIDDEN: Authenticated user lacks the required permission.
x-error-codes.NOT_FOUND: Requested resource does not exist or is not visible to the caller.
x-error-codes.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests; retry after Retry-After seconds.
x-error-codes.INTERNAL_ERROR: Unexpected server failure; the correlation ID is logged for support.
x-error-codes.INVALID_WEBHOOK_SIGNATURE: Webhook signature or credentials failed verification.

x-observability.description: Every request receives or propagates X-Correlation-Id. Include it when reporting failures.
